title: hieracium loscosianum subsp. pseudobaeticum
intro: Hieracium loscosianum subsp. pseudobaeticum, commonly known as Baetic Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to treat inflammation, wounds, and skin irritations. The health benefits of Baetic Hawkweed include its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
